verdict.rationale: Docs mention running Droid from terminal/editor/tests and Git workflow, plus bash mode for shell commands and tiered autonomy for CI/CD via droid exec, implying it could run test suites, but there is no explicit documentation describing an agent autonomously generating tests and validating its own changes before proposing a diff. missing for 10: explicit documentation of self-generated test creation, a documented test-run-then-fix loop tied to a proposed diff, and any hands-on/independent evidence confirming this workflow.
